reviews.text: I brought my cat Django, after seeing four other vets. Dr. Federica was able to immediately diagnose the problem, and now Django is doing much better. I also advised my mother to bring her two Sphinx cats, and now this clinic is our go-to clinic.
Young and competent vets, I'm very happy with them. I already knew the practice, having had another Chihuahua.

I took my three-month-old kitten for her first visit and I couldn't have asked for anything better. We were greeted by an extraordinary vet, whom I sincerely thank for her immense kindness and the obvious love she puts into her work. Thanks also to the other doctors at the clinic I met; they were always helpful and professional. Leaving your little one in such safe hands really makes a difference; I felt incredibly at ease!

I've been entrusting my cat to Dr. Tiziana Belli's care for 13 years. From the first time, I was won over by her professionalism, the attentive and meticulous way she cares for him, and, last but not least, the love she shows my furry friend when she tries to calm him down. The entire team at the clinic is made up of highly competent, helpful, and honest people.
Very well-trained and kind veterinary staff.

After changing three vets, I found Dr. Tiziana on the recommendation of a doctor. She saved my dog, who was dying due to the incompetence of the previous ones. LOCAL!! Be wary of negative reviews because some people are annoying and exasperating with their easy criticism.

Wonderful people who care for our animals with passion and love, as well as unmatched professionalism and expertise. I take my furry friends to them, which is 85 km from my home. I'm a very careful person when it comes to my dogs, and this has pushed me to change clinics two or three times. But now when I take them to Dr. Federica De Federicis, I always leave feeling calm and satisfied with what she explains and how she treats my two dogs. What can I say.... Seeing is believing, as a slogan from a few years ago said. I've done it, and I'll never change.

He's been "my" vet for 11 years. It was recommended to me, and I do it myself. Their professionalism is unquestionable. Patient care makes all the difference; you know you'll receive all the care you need, and the team is available if needed, even when they shouldn't (a well-deserved break). You just have to be patient sometimes due to the high number of visits per day, but if there are so many patients, what do you think is the only plausible explanation??? 🤔

It's a veterinary center, where the doctors aren't ready to take your money like many others. The practice's primary concern is advising you on the potential consequences of unnecessary treatments and strives to have the best interests of the animal and its caregivers in mind. I've been to several other centers, and their primary concern is to present possible tests, often useless, to get out of trouble and verify with lab data whether the treatments are necessary or not. After spending a lot of money needlessly, they give you a treatment that's often unnecessary.
In this center, however, we discuss the animal and all its needs, and then the money comes second.
They are Angels at the service of our Friends.
I recommend it to everyone.
Best regards, everyone.
Competent, professional, and always available veterinarians. Love and passion for animals. Thank you.
Excellent studio recommended by experts for dogs and cats... fantastic people.
I've been going to these wonderful vets for 30 years, hospitality, love and professionalism❤️
My trusted veterinarian for over 20 years. Extremely competent and empathetic.

I take my three cats to this clinic. All the vets are always attentive and truly love their work. In February, I had one of them with herpes, which was dying. They were very careful with the treatment, and now he's doing much better. Thank you.
Everyone is very efficient even if you are not a customer... absolutely kind
